decision: Jira epics and tickets are synced read-only via POST /rest/api/3/search/jql into the WorkItems table using idempotent upsert.
key_insight: Jira epics and tickets are synced read-only via POST /rest/api/3/search/jql into the WorkItems table using idempotent upsert.
alternatives_considered: Use gh CLI for Jira like GitHub integration
rejected_reason: No gh CLI equivalent for Jira; direct HTTPS is cleaner with no external CLI dependency
GET /rest/api/3/search was removed by Atlassian per changelog CHANGE-2046
